selection_rationale: A ranked City capital-program batch: one complete voter-facing 2021 General Obligation Bond book, its twelve published excerpts, and two adjacent property fact sheets reviewed together to preserve one complete original without redundant excerpt archives.

decisions.title: 2021 General Obligation Bond Program by Purpose
decisions.description: Compiles Albuquerque's voter-facing 2021 General Obligation Bond program by purpose, preserving ballot questions, project titles, scopes, and $140 million in proposed funding for public safety, community facilities, parks, streets, transit, drainage, housing, and redevelopment.
processing_notes: Original authoritative City PDF preserved without modification.
Reviewed against extracted text; its table of contents and project sections establish that it contains the published category excerpts, bond-question sheet, and program summary.
